fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: Each topic we fetched offsets for.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: Each partition in the topic we fetched offsets for.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code 0, or if there was no error.

fields.name: LeaderEpoch
fields.about: The leader epoch of the partition.

fields.name: EndOffset
fields.about: The end offset of the epoch.
